D009-D011_h001.question:
It’s been a really rough year. Most days, I just feel this heavy, sad cloud over me. Like, even when things go well at the store, I just don't feel anything, you know? It's weird, I used to love hitting my sales targets, but lately, I just don't care. My brain feels so sluggish, like it takes all my energy just to think through simple tasks for work. A few months ago, it got so bad… I actually tried to overdose on some pills I’d saved up. I just wanted it all to stop.

But then, about a month ago, things got really hectic. I wasn't sleeping at all, like maybe an hour or two a night, and I felt buzzing with energy, ready to go. I'd be pacing around my apartment after closing, just needing to *do* something, anything – picking up clothes, organizing my makeup collection for hours. I'd talk a mile a minute to my friends, barely letting them get a word in. Everything annoyed me, little things at work would just set me off, and I’d snap at my colleagues, which isn't like me. All of that felt like a whirlwind, but I was still able to manage the store just fine; it didn't really mess up my work.

Honestly, the constant anxiety is what’s really getting to me. I worry about *everything* – my job performance, my finances, what people think of me. It's like my brain won't shut off, and these racing thoughts about all my worries just fuel that anxious feeling. I get so worked up that I can't sit still or focus, trying to plan for every possible bad outcome. It’s exhausting.
D009-D011_h001.options:
A. Generalized Anxiety Disorder
    B. Adjustment Disorder
    C. Persistent Depressive Disorder
    D. Bipolar II Disorder

D009-D011_h002.question:

I can sleep for hours and still wake up feeling utterly drained, like I haven't rested at all. There was even a point, a few months back, where things got so bad I started researching ways to just… end it. Not actively, but the thoughts were there, and I even started putting some of my affairs in order.

Then, about a month ago, it was like a switch flipped. Suddenly I had this burst of energy. I was snapping at everyone, getting angry over the smallest things. My wife said I was practically vibrating, always needing to be doing something, couldn’t sit still for a minute. I barely slept for weeks, maybe an hour or two a night, but I felt absolutely fine, even energized. My words were flying out, couldn't stop talking, felt like I had to get everything out. I even took on three extra auctions, working tirelessly, feeling totally on top of my game, though my wife said I was just being reckless. But I actually lost money on them.

The thing is, even during that busy, energetic period, and especially now, I'm just constantly worried. My mind races, jumping from one potential problem to the next – finances, the kids, my business. It’s like a constant hum of anxiety that drives these restless thoughts and makes me feel so jumpy and agitated. It’s hard to focus on anything else."
D009-D011_h002.options:
A. Generalized Anxiety Disorder
    B. Adjustment Disorder
    C. Persistent Depressive Disorder
    D. Bipolar II Disorder
